definitions.explanation: The process of saving or writing data to storage media such as hard drives, USB drives, or CDs.
A message, comment, or entry posted on an online forum, message board, or comment section.

notes:
{書|か}き{込|こ}み has two main meanings: writing data to storage, and posting online.

SENSE 1 - DATA WRITING:
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: writing/saving
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: write-protected
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧: write speed

SENSE 2 - ONLINE POSTING:
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to post, to comment
- ⟦{匿名|とくめい}→匿名：11797_tokumei⟧{書|か}き{込|こ}み: anonymous post
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: comment section

USAGE:
- In online contexts, {書|か}き{込|こ}み is commonly shortened to かきこ or カキコ
